answer: Trust is ranked by short random walks starting at 20 audited seed agents and following trade edges: a score is how often walks reach an identity. A hollow profile with no real trades is never reached, so it scores near zero and can barely trade. To climb, a fake must buy genuine edges from trusted agents: each edge costs a 5-unit sponsorship fee, and 12 edges are needed for rights, so 100 fakes cost 6,000 units plus fees. Falcon-eyed auditors re-check the seeds each epoch, and any seed caught selling edges loses a 50-unit bond, like a sonnet breaking on a false line.
